strings.subtitle: — Fiilla duššu —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Geasemii ii leat. Geavat vulit boalu.
strings.ssd_warning: Várro! SSD:s TRIM dihte dán metodda ii garantiere duššuma. Dát prográmma lea dušše HDD várás.
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS molssaeaktu dieđovuođut (ADS) eai leat meannuduvvon.
• USN lođa ii leat buhtistuvvon.
• Suoivana kopiijat ja cloud-synkroniseren
  (OneDrive jna.) eai leat váikkuhan.
strings.status_full: Sisdoallu dievaslaččat badjelčállojuvvon nollain. Eahpevejolaš fas haga — neavttut oidnet dušše nolla.
strings.status_fast: Oaivi, bahta ja 4 MB sierran badjelčállojuvvon. Báhkka ii leat váikkuhan, muhto geahppu dihte fiilla ollesveardásaš fas haga eahpevejolaš. Luhtalaš dokumeanttaid várás geavat DIEVAS modusa.
strings.status_empty: Fiila lei guoktil, badjelčállin ii dárbbašuvvon. Duššojuvvui.
strings.error_permission: Ii beasa fiilla lusa. Sáhttá leat rabas eará prográmmas. Gidde ja geahččal fas.
strings.error_not_found: Fiila ii gávdnon. Sáhttá leat jo duššojuvvon.
strings.error_is_symlink: Dát lea symbóla bálggis. Bálgáid ii sáhte duššut — mihttomearri fiila báhcá.
strings.error_reparse: Dát lea sahtebáiki fiila (OneDrive dahje sullii). Dan dieđut leat cloudas, ii diskan — ii leat mii duššut.
strings.error_not_file: Dát ii leat fiila (máhppa dahje eará). Gease fiilla.
strings.error_hardlinks: Dán fiillas leat eará garra bálgát ({n} oktiibuot). Garra bálgáin ii leat váldo bálggis — buot nammat leat seammá. Jus duššut dán bálgá bokte, dieđut badjelčállojuvvojit ja čuohppojuvvojit 32 byte:ii, muhto stub báhcá beassan eará bálgáid bokte. Duššo buot bálgáid ovdal.
strings.error_compressed:
Fiila lea komprimerejuvvon, šifrerejuvvon dahje sparse. Nollain badjelčállin ii garantiere boares dieđuid duššuma, dasgo NTFS vurkkoda daid earálágan láhkai.

Sihko attribuhta: olgeš boallu → Iešvuođat → Viiddiduvvon → sihko "Komprimere" ja/dahje "Šifrere". De geavat SHREDDER fas.
